findings.text: non-blocking: _run_over_tree runs the base arm through a subprocess that only sets PYTHONPATH to the extracted tree and never asserts the imported module's __file__, so if resolution resolved reckon from the installed editable path both arms would run head code and the parity assertion at :430 would hold trivially.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is that every ledger read inside one batch dispatch be answered from a single index decode; the gained commits give the payload region one key owner (reckon/ledger.py:1675 _payload_slot), so the refreshing read and the read-pass reader cannot disagree about the key.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_batch_decodes_the_ledger_index_once.py with a 200-row home, ten entries over three plans, at-most-once counters on _index_payload and _last_good_index_data, and a parity arm against the base revision; commit 37626ae38a adds that arm (tests/test_a_batch_decodes_the_ledger_index_once.py:414 _extract_revision, :430 the comparison) and the manifest records 55 passed at 37626ae38a.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py, reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_a_batch_decodes_the_ledger_index_once.py and the node fragment; the gained commits touch only reckon/ledger.py, the test file and the fragment, all inside that set.
VERDICT manifest: read at the run directory; it records commits a5ea48f256, 37626ae38a and 9af0947d38, both suite arms at their own revisions, the negative-control log naming 11 decodes over 10 entries, the all_debug measurement at 0.060 s against 0.095 s per entry, and ruff clean on the staged paths; crew check --manifest on it returned ok with no findings.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from a5ea48f256 to 9af0947d38b3; 37626ae38a replaces the two copied region-key lookups in reckon/ledger.py with _payload_slot and adds the base-revision parity arm plus the fragment corrections, and 9af0947d38 is a one-line evidence correction, 3 files and 162 insertions in total.
CALL_SITES: reckon/ledger.py:2155, reckon/ledger.py:1871, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1136
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1675 gives the payload region one key owner and both readers at :1728 and :1792 take it, so a batch still costs one decode and no reader can construct a second key.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the base-revision parity arm at tests/test_a_batch_decodes_the_ledger_index_once.py:430 compares against the code the change replaces, but the manifest's base arm ran 1 of the 93 test files that import reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py, so the done_when's plural file set is under-measured for a ledger hot-path change.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff a5ea48f256..9af0947d38 changes only reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_a_batch_decodes_the_ledger_index_once.py and the node fragment, every one of them a declared path.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: the at-most-once counters at tests/test_a_batch_decodes_the_ledger_index_once.py:277 redden under the recorded negative control (11 decodes, logs/negative-control.log), but the parity arm at :430 does not assert which tree its subprocess imported.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/ledger.py:1675 follows the docstring-and-private-helper idiom of the surrounding readers and introduces no plan, ticket or version label.
SCORE reuse: 18
JUSTIFICATION reuse: _payload_slot consolidates two existing copies rather than adding a third; a capability search over reckon/ for materialising a revision found only reckon/crew/routing.py:606, which recognises git-archive trees rather than extracting one.
FINDING tests/test_a_batch_decodes_the_ledger_index_once.py:371 non-blocking: _run_over_tree runs the base arm through a subprocess that only sets PYTHONPATH to the extracted tree and never asserts the imported module's __file__, so if resolution resolved reckon from the installed editable path both arms would run head code and the parity assertion at :430 would hold trivially.
